title: Za'atar Chicken with Honey-Roast Carrots, Bulgur & Tahini Yogurt
description: Za'atar-crusted chicken thighs roasted on one tray with carrots and red onion, with lemony bulgur, tahini yogurt and pomegranate. Garlic-free.

steps.title: Roast the veg at 200 °C
steps.text: Heat the oven to 200 °C (fan). Toss the carrots and red onion on a large tray with 10 ml of the olive oil and ½ tsp salt. Roast 15 min.

steps.title: Season the chicken
steps.text: Meanwhile, rub the chicken with the za'atar, the remaining 10 ml olive oil and ½ tsp salt.

steps.title: Roast chicken and veg
steps.text: Push the veg to the sides, lay the chicken in the middle and roast 25 min until cooked through (75 °C inside). Drizzle the honey over the carrots for the last 5 min.

steps.title: Soak the bulgur
steps.text: While the chicken roasts, put the bulgur in a bowl with a pinch of salt, pour over the boiling water, cover and leave 15 min. Fluff with a fork and stir in the lemon zest, half the lemon juice and half the herbs.

steps.title: Make the tahini yogurt
steps.text: Stir together the yogurt, tahini, the rest of the lemon juice and a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Plate and split
steps.text: Bulgur 100 g / 20 g uncooked weight (Matthias / Nyuszika); chicken about 435 g / 185 g raw (~70/30); carrots and onion about 60/40; tahini yogurt 140 g / 60 g. Finish with the pomegranate and remaining herbs.

notes: If Kifli has no za'atar, mix 1 tbsp dried thyme, 1 tsp sumac and 1 tsp toasted sesame seeds. One pomegranate gives plenty of seeds.
